Summary of websites posted in the 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com — Reports on the latest job report, noting a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a rustic atmosphere, and guests enjoy panoramic city views through large windows. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire complete the experience.

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, simple start, but I noticed it only shows your email address and doesn't have much content yet. I'd suggest adding a short bio, some info about your interests or work, and maybe a contact form or links to your social profiles to make it more engaging. Also, you may want to double-check which email you'd like displayed publicly, since there appear to be two listed. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's great that you share your love of hiking! The site is quite minimal right now, so I'd suggest adding more content like posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, and tips for fellow hikers. That would make it much more engaging and give visitors a reason to come back. Nice work so far!
